description: This file contains CSS styles for the Tic Tac Toe web application, including theme management, styles for the main app container, headers, links, and button styles.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container with center-aligned text and background color that changes based on the chosen theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styling for the application logo, including size and pointer events.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styling for the header of the application, with flexible display properties.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for links within the application, including color and transition effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button for toggling the theme, styled with position, color, border, and hover effects.
